title: Spanish Gold Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Countertop Valet, Solid Brass, Allied Brass
description:
Keep paper towels close at hand and your kitchen countertop clutter-free with a freestanding paper towel holder that stays put when you need it in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished kitchens. This solid brass countertop valet uses a weighted base to help prevent tipping and a felt pad to help protect your surfaces from scratches.

• Clear the counter and organize cleanup with a paper towel stand
• Tear sheets confidently—weighted base adds stability
• Help protect stone, wood, and other counters with a felt bottom pad
• Designed for a crisp, modern look and offered in multiple designer finish options
• Covered by a limited lifetime warranty

This paper towel holder also works as a paper towel stand and kitchen towel holder for everyday use.

Specs: Dimensions: 5 in L x 14 in H x 5 in W. Product weight: 4.8 lb. Mounting: freestanding (no wall mount required). Included: paper towel holder. Warranty: limited lifetime.
